cause_quote: The new action guard installed `await opts.page.route("**", handler);`, putting every request through Playwright interception during existing browser interactions.
user_saw: A server could receive a cross-origin request during a browser action even when its CORS policy denied the request.
summary: The fix replaces catch-all Playwright routing with document-only CDP interception so Chromium handles CORS preflights natively.
reasoning: I checked the introducing diff and its parent and confirmed that existing click actions previously ran without the catch-all route added by #104254. The fix PR's Chromium comparison showed that the rejecting server received only the preflight without the route and received the cross-origin request with it. Guarded `goto` already used catch-all routing before #104254, and its introduction predates the available local file history.
